evidence_items.locator: Abstract; qualifications in sections 4.1–4.4 and Appendix A.5
evidence_items.explanation: The original evaluation reports continuing sensitivity to altered arithmetic questions and irrelevant clauses. Its detailed results also identify negligible basic-variation drops for some models and strong o1-preview performance on difficulty variants, so the evidence supports persistent failures rather than uniform fragility.

This later reassessment finds statistically significant changes in only eight of twenty evaluated models under the original prompt, with number magnitude explaining some effects. It weakens blanket interpretations of Apple's results but still identifies model-specific failures; these later experiments are context outside the target period.
